subject: Packaging options for pilot: upgrade/downgrade path and bundled features
messages:

Cc: Jason Lee <jason.lee@curatech.com>

Subject: Exploring Redwood packaging for production pilot

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and cost profile looked promising. We are finalizing internal sign-off for a 90-day production pilot and need clarity on packaging/price mechanics before we present to procurement. Two quick asks:  

1) If we start on the Compact tier with the option to upgrade to Throughput (reserved GPUs) mid-pilot, how does prorating/crediting work for committed capacity?
2) We want a single bundled SKU that includes: private deployment (VPC), 24/7 support, and Redwood Optimize recommendations. Can you propose a Pilot bundle and the expected unit economics?

Attached is a high-level forecast (placeholder — will follow with the real file). Also, procurement will request a pilot discount for an annual commit if we convert. What levels have you offered for similar customers?

Appreciate a short written proposal we can review — no long slide decks.

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear asks and great to hear the demo landed. Short proposal below (will follow with a formal term sheet and the actual forecast attachment once you send the full spreadsheet).

Quick answers up front:
- Upgrade/downgrade: We support prorated crediting on committed Dedicated capacity. If you upgrade mid-term we bill the delta going forward; if you downgrade we apply unused future committed credit back at 50% of remaining committed value (this preserves capacity reservation economics).
- Bundled SKU: We can create a "Pilot Plus" bundle that includes a private VPC control plane, Redwood Optimize (weekly recommendations), and a 24/7 support addon with a 2-hour P1 SLA for the pilot term.

Pilot Plus (90-day outline):
- Start: Compact (hosted) for dev/onboarding, migrate to Dedicated pool (1x A100 equiv) for production cutover.
- Credits: 30% burst credits included, automatic prefix caching enabled.
- Discounting: For pilot customers we typically offer a 10–15% pilot discount on hosted unit rates; for an annual commit on conversion we can structure a 12% discount baseline with room to extend based on commit size.

Next steps: Please send the forecast file and any procurement doc samples. I will put together a short term sheet with explicit upgrade/downgrade math and a sample amendment for the pilot discount.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@curatech.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 14:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Packaging options for pilot: upgrade/downgrade path and bundled features

Hi Marta — copied to outline a concise, legal-friendly set of options you can share with procurement and legal. I kept the language high level but explicit on the math so it’s easy to transfer to a term sheet.

Pilot Plus — recommended commercial structure:
- Pilot term: 90 days; starts on migration to Dedicated.
- Pricing: Pilot discount = 15% off hosted token/throughput rate for the pilot term. If CuraTech signs a 12-month annual commit within 30 days of pilot close, the pilot discount converts into a 12% annual credit applied evenly across the 12 months (no retroactive cash-back).
- Upgrade: If CuraTech upgrades to a larger Dedicated pool mid-term, you pay the incremental committed capacity at the prevailing rate immediately; any pre-paid credits are reallocated proportionally.
- Downgrade/early exit: If CuraTech downgrades or terminates early, remaining unused committed value is credited at 50% back to CuraTech to apply against future Redwood services (applies to committed Dedicated capacity only).
- Pause retention: Dedicated pools may be paused up to 30 days per 12-month period for a retention fee equal to 10% of the monthly committed capacity cost per paused month. During pause, burst credits are suspended; on unpause, cache warming is performed with no additional charge for the first 48 hours.

Add-ons (one-line): 24/7 support = $2,500/mo for the pilot; Redwood Optimize weekly = included; Private control plane (VPC) = $1,200/mo during pilot (waived for first 30 days).

Docs and next steps:
- I’ll draft a two-page amendment (PilotPlus-term-sheet.docx) with the above clauses and an early-exit appendix.
- If the commercial looks acceptable, Priyom will send a DocuSign link for an amendment and we’ll loop CS/security to deliver SOC2 evidence and a deployment readiness checklist.

Karthik
Head of Commercials, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PilotPlus-term-sheet.docx (draft)]
